open_findings.observed: The current-source proof now rests entirely on the empty-vault probe: in source-flip test 2 (slugs listed with the vault path emptied equal a baseline read) and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (each consumer's output with only '02 - Sales & Hit List' emptied equals the current output). No code in these files, and no published evidence (one-line commit message; the manifest records only typecheck; no report on disk), shows that the probe catches the defect it exists for: a consumer still discovering prospects from the vault. If the probe did not actually remove vault prospect discovery (a wrong directory name, a symlinked prospect dir, or a reader that ignores ASCEND_VAULT_PATH), every comparison would pass vacuously. CURRENT-SOURCE-AND-CONTROLS requires demonstrating at least one control going red for the intended defect, and FOCUSED-CONTROLLED-PROOF requires exact focused results and a post-run clean tree. Neither can be verified from the published object.

open_findings.minimal_repair: In the three allowed files only: (1) in source-flip test 2 and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (or one consumer test), add an in-suite control that, with the probe path active, sets ASCEND_PROSPECT_SOURCE='vault' for one read and asserts that prospect discovery returns 0 (e.g. listProspects() is empty and the knowledge-index prospect registry is empty), while the Postgres-mode read under the same probe still equals the baseline. Restore the source setting in finally. (2) Commit with a message body recording the focused controlled run of the three suites: exact per-suite passed/failed/skipped counts, the control result, confirmation that no tracked file changed (git status empty), and the read-only applogin/scratch-schema cleanup check. No URLs, values or secrets. Then freeze r2.
open_findings.observed: The current-source proof now rests entirely on the empty-vault probe: in source-flip test 2 (slugs listed with the vault path emptied equal a baseline read) and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (each consumer's output with only '02 - Sales & Hit List' emptied equals the current output). No code in these files, and no published evidence (one-line commit message; the manifest records only typecheck; no report on disk), shows that the probe catches the defect it exists for: a consumer still discovering prospects from the vault. If the probe did not actually remove vault prospect discovery (a wrong directory name, a symlinked prospect dir, or a reader that ignores ASCEND_VAULT_PATH), every comparison would pass vacuously. CURRENT-SOURCE-AND-CONTROLS requires demonstrating at least one control going red for the intended defect, and FOCUSED-CONTROLLED-PROOF requires exact focused results and a post-run clean tree. Neither can be verified from the published object.

regression_proof.description: The new in-suite control passes in the focused controlled run, and would fail if the probe left vault prospect discovery intact. The r2 commit body records the three suites' exact counts and a clean post-run tree.

open_findings.minimal_repair: After the owner decides the vault question: if approved, give the launcher a fresh private empty vault (mktemp -d, mode 0700, the three expected top-level folders). Add ASCEND_VAULT_PATH to the allowlist, and fail closed unless its realpath is inside that temp root and differs from any vault path in .env.local or .env.production.local (compare without printing). Then re-run login plus /sales/list plus the prospect page through the exact launcher and port Oscar will use, and record the non-secret results. Correct the launcher description (production build of a staged copy).
open_findings.observed: The checkpoint says the Sales list and prospect detail pages rendered with no errors, and gives `node /private/tmp/accept-db-start.mjs` as Oscar's verified iPhone command. That launcher (/private/tmp/accept-db-production.mjs) runs a production `next start` from a staged build, not 'the normal Turbopack app' the checkpoint describes, and its environment allowlist has no ASCEND_VAULT_PATH. The candidate's vault reader throws when that variable is unset (core/vault/paths.ts:9-12). The builder has since reported to the owner that the Sales page error persists under this launcher and that no verified launch command exists yet. The published IPHONE-PREFLIGHT evidence therefore does not describe the command it hands to Oscar.

regression_proof.description: The checkpoint records sign-in 200 and a Sales list and detail render with no error through `node /private/tmp/accept-db-start.mjs` (or its successor) at the recorded time.

No new Sales behavior, dashboard, pipeline, notes or promotion change, and no unrelated production change. It names the exact deploy SHA and tree to be re-pinned at authorization time, and the 010 SHA-256 as pinned in core/recovery/profile-registry.ts.

Document, with file and line evidence, why migrate and deploy must be ONE stopped-service window. 010 revokes sales UPDATE of status/assigned_to/first_contact/last_contact, replaces the owner's table UPDATE with column grants, and adds prospects_status_has_transition. The serving D1 build (ba648d3) marks promotion with a direct `UPDATE prospects SET status = 'closed-won'` (core/db/prospects.ts:523), which 010 denies. The promoted build cannot run on 009 (the Sales reads need the 010 tables). Verify every other D1 write path against the 010 grants, and confirm the new build needs no environment name production lacks. Order: bootout, migrate, verify, build, bootstrap, smoke. The D1 .next rollback clone is NOT a valid rollback after 010. Also correct, in the contract, the preflight's claim that promotion bypasses the stage command: markProspectPromoted already calls ascend_transition_stage with cause 'promotion' (core/db/prospects.ts:517).

Specify a fresh pre-migration backup of production and its recovery proof. The orchestrator's `prove --owner` selects only the registry's pinned CURRENT artifact (post-009 v2), so a fresh v3 artifact must be proven with the sanctioned runner `scripts/recovery-verify.sh --artifact <fresh> [--r1c-root]` (R1b then R1c, same-version 17.6), plus the post-restore profile expected for ledger 009. Include the after-artifact for ledger 010 verified against post-010-v1. No new recovery authority.

Specify owner-run read-only production checks using the existing pinned-TLS, BEGIN READ ONLY pattern (counts only). BEFORE: ledger exactly 001-009 with recorded checksums; no 010 objects present; the prospect count and the no-transition-needed state recorded; no application session holding locks. AFTER: ledger 001-010 with 010's checksum equal to the pinned value; the four Sales tables, three SECURITY DEFINER functions (empty search_path), the trigger, RLS forced, and the exact grant set; business row counts unchanged. The migration goes through the existing migrate path only, alone in its window.

Extend scripts/deploy-smoke.mjs with Sales checks. Read-only checks (run automatically): owner and partner login, /sales queue renders bounded sections, /sales/list, a prospect detail, owner controls present for the owner and absent for the partner, no missing-relation errors. Write checks (contact, follow-up, owner reassign/reopen) are OFF by default and run only under an explicit owner flag, because production contacts and events are append-only. Keep the documented email-via-env input (no in-script prompt, per the D1 keep-alive race). Add a static test for the smoke's check list and its write-flag gate, and classify it in gate-2g1.ts.

State per-step stop conditions and recovery. Before migration: abort, no change. Migration fails or verification mismatches: stop, keep the service down, and restore from the fresh artifact only on explicit owner decision. After deploy: forward-fix; a restore loses writes made since the backup and needs owner approval. Serving-tree preconditions: clean tree at the pinned SHA; the uncommitted apps/os/next.config.ts reverted; iCloud ' 2'/' 3' duplicates removed from source and .next; no other session or dev server using the main checkout.

Add scripts/apply-migration-010.mjs and scripts/verify-migration-010.mjs, modelled exactly on the reviewed 009 pair. Direct endpoint only; pinned TLS; refuse SSL URL parameters; a frozen 010 SHA-256 equal to the profile registry's L010; exactly one migration applied; ledger exactly 001-009 with zero checksum drift before; every 010 object absent before; a row-count guard; importing only core/db/migrate.ts. The default `--check` is read-only (default_transaction_read_only=on) and applying requires an explicit production flag. The verify matrix is frozen before execution and is read-only: ledger/checksum, four tables, RLS forced, policies, the exact grants (including the REVOKEs on prospects), three SECURITY DEFINER functions with empty search_path, the trigger, and unchanged business counts. Static tests must prove the checksum pin, the refusal paths and the read-only default without any database.

scripts/backup-production.sh A5 (lines 121-125) refuses unless production's ledger equals every file in core/db/schema. From a 010 tree it therefore refuses to back up 009 production. The contract must specify taking the pre-migration backup from a separate clean worktree at a named commit whose schema directory ends at 009 and whose profile registry has the post-009 profile, then the after-backup from the deploy SHA once 010 is applied. Do not weaken A5.

production-2f-partner.test.ts (2026-08-29) asserts the sales principal is DENIED finance:*, documents:*, time:*, audits:*, portal:admin, production:toggle, import:run, promote, prospects:identity, clients:* and sops:read. STAGE2G section 29 Ruling 5 (provisioning half unchanged, split must not weaken either half) is honored: only a stale expectation is corrected, and it is strictly stronger (it now also proves prospects:manage is withheld). A diff review must show no other hunk.

tests/architecture/partner-oneshot.test.ts, no database: the one-shot contains no hand-typed capability list; the boundary check is the first it() in the provisioning describe and precedes every INSERT/UPDATE; mutants (adding a withheld capability to sales, or removing a held one, applied to a copy of the table in memory) are detected by the same derivation. required_manual_checks.description: Since COORD-SERVER-001 (98838b6), assertProofIsolation refuses ASCEND_VAULT_PATH in every non-server phase ('vault input is limited to server proof'), and the orchestrator builds the db environment without it (apps/os/scripts/proof-orchestrator.mjs:275). tests/db/production-2e-consumer-parity.test.ts is classified PROVEN phase db in gate-2g1.ts and is gated on ASCEND_DATABASE_URL AND ASCEND_VAULT_PATH (describeIfDb, line 59), so it always skips in the db phase and gate-proof rejects the skip.
